subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- October 20, 2026
body:
**AcreetionOS Newsletter - October 20, 2026**

**Exciting News: Linux Plumbers Conference Videos Now Available!**

The Linux Plumbers Conference (LPC) 2026 videos are now available for viewing. This year's conference featured a wide range of talks and presentations on various topics related to Linux and open-source software. The videos can be accessed on the LPC website, providing a valuable resource for developers, users, and enthusiasts alike.

**Community News**

* The AcreetionOS community has been actively engaged in various discussions on our Discord server, with topics ranging from Linux kernel development to user experiences with AcreetionOS. We encourage all users to join the conversation and share their thoughts and ideas.
* The AcreetionOS team has been working on improving the user experience, and we're excited to announce that we'll be releasing a new version of the distribution soon. Stay tuned for more information!

**Practical Tip: Secure Your System with Regular Updates**

To ensure the security and stability of your AcreetionOS system, it's essential to keep your packages up-to-date. You can do this by running the following command in your terminal:

```bash
sudo pacman -Syu
```

This will update your system to the latest available packages, including security updates. Remember to restart your system after the update to apply the changes.

That's all for this week's newsletter. Thank you for being part of the AcreetionOS community!
